chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"Do not make up the Witr prayer of your night, meaning on the two Eids, if you missed it, until you have prayed the midday prayer on that day."

key_terms.الزَّوَالَ: the midday prayer time, here referring to the noon prayer
key_terms.الْعِيدَيْنِ: the two Eid days, Eid al-Fiṭr and Eid al-Aḍḥā
key_terms.وَتْرَ: the Witr prayer being referred to for making up

ai.seo_question: If I missed the Witr prayer on the night before Eid, when should I make it up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the order of prayers on the days of the two Eids. It instructs that if the Witr prayer of the previous night was missed, it should not be made up before performing the midday prayer on that day.
